release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.4.1 — Billion-Dollar UI Craft & Authenticity Architecture:
• Symmetrical Apple Squircle Medallion: Replaced oblong rectangle letterbox frame on Welcome screen with a 1:1 concentric squircle medallion with specular edge highlights.
• Anti-AI Slop Messaging: Purged AI generator buzzwords. Upgraded brand slogan to 'Learn • Play • Prove • Unlock' and 'Transform screen time into genuine academic mastery'.
• Direct Vercel Legal Integration: Added live Terms of Service & Privacy Policy deep links to https://focusdefend.vercel.app/terms and https://focusdefend.vercel.app/privacy across Welcome, Student Profile, and Parent Security screens.
• Curated Curriculum MCQ Protection: Strictly filtered out all placeholder/template variant questions; guaranteed 100% authentic curriculum questions with genuine options.
• Native App Name Resolution: Fixed 'android Paused' display glitch to query PackageManager and resolve authentic human-readable app names (Instagram, YouTube, Chrome, etc.).
• Android Autofill Visual Cleanliness: Eliminated ugly yellow background autofill highlight on email/password input wells.
• Purged Crypto Slop: Restored authentic educational focus credits across rewards wallet and navigation tabs.
